selection_basis: Public source metadata only: a 139-species Merianieae floral-trait frame, explicit corolla.colour field, phylogeny tip-label field x, and author-provided branch-length phylogeny are documented before any row-level corolla colour is opened.

source_identity.source_note: The Dryad README states that floraltraits.csv contains floral traits for 139 Merianieae species, x contains phylogeny tip labels, corolla.colour is the colour field, and Marcelo_Meris.tre is the phylogenetic hypothesis. The linked Zenodo record is the author analysis package.

source_recovery_rule.preferred: Recover the exact Zenodo skripts.zip whose MD5 matches the frozen Zenodo record, then use only 1_morphospaces_disparity/floraltraits.csv and 1_morphospaces_disparity/Marcelo_Meris.tre from the same author analysis folder.
source_recovery_rule.fallback: No alternate same-name tree from another Zenodo analysis folder is substituted. If either required folder-specific member is absent, HOLD_SOURCE.
source_recovery_rule.duplicate_member_rule: Not applicable after folder-specific identity freeze; exact archive suffixes are required.

trait_semantics.fine_state: exact nonmissing corolla.colour string after trim/lowercase/collapse-whitespace only; no synonym, hue, or semantic merging
trait_semantics.coarse_state: WHITE iff normalized fine string is exactly 'white'; otherwise NONWHITE
trait_semantics.composite_or_ambiguous_label_rule: Retain as its exact fine state; do not reinterpret semantically. If the source encoding is not a categorical string field, HOLD_SCHEMA.

crosswalk_rule.method: exact normalized intersection of floraltraits.csv x and source-tree tip labels
crosswalk_rule.normalization: trim, replace underscores with spaces, collapse whitespace, lowercase

hidden_memory_test.opportunity_rule: after rare fine-state filtering, retained fine-state count > retained coarse-state count and both coarse states are present
hidden_memory_test.metric: ROC_AUC among pairs sharing the same coarse state
hidden_memory_test.null: permute retained fine labels within coarse groups, preserving fine-state counts
hidden_memory_test.pass_rule: centered conditional AUC > 0 and one-sided permutation P <= 0.05

relation_to_existing_evidence.purpose: additional future-facing replication under the v0.4 realization architecture; cannot retroactively rescue any prior FAIL

source_identity_erratum.reason: Zenodo archive preview exposes two non-identical Marcelo_Meris.tre copies in different analysis folders. The Dryad README states that folder 1_morphospaces_disparity contains floraltraits.csv and the Merianieae phylogeny used for floral-space analyses. The trait and tree are therefore frozen to that same folder before source bytes or row-level corolla colour are opened.

ecological_secondary_frozen_before_colou.opening_order: identifier-only crosswalk first; then estimated_pollinator values may be opened and frozen before corolla.colour is accessed
ecological_secondary_frozen_before_colou.normalization: trim/lowercase/collapse whitespace only; missing tokens remain missing; no guild merging
ecological_secondary_frozen_before_colou.frame: intersection of primary retained colour frame and nonmissing estimated_pollinator
ecological_secondary_frozen_before_colou.diagnostic: Compare the observed within-coarse phylogenetic AUC with (A) fine-label permutations within coarse state and (B) fine-label permutations within coarse x estimated_pollinator strata.

interpretation.residual_pass: If the pollinator-conditioned centered effect remains >0 with one-sided P<=0.05, nested lineage organization persists beyond the source-defined pollinator grouping.
interpretation.attenuation_only: If conditioning on pollinator grouping substantially raises the null expectation or removes residual significance, pollinator regime is compatible with accounting for part of the hidden organization.

ecological_secondary_frozen_before_colou.boundary: secondary ecological diagnostic only; cannot rescue a failed primary hidden-memory test

temporal_realization_prediction_frozen_b.predictor: fine visible-colour signed excess-retention area over relative phylogenetic divergence depth
temporal_realization_prediction_frozen_b.predictor_estimator: same 10 equal-pair-count bin estimator as the Flower-clades-51 historical persistence analysis; relative depth = patristic/(2*crown height); exact finite-sample same-state baseline; trapezoidal signed excess area
temporal_realization_prediction_frozen_b.source_tree_requirement: root-to-tip CV <= 1e-8; otherwise temporal prediction is HOLD and primary hidden-memory test continues
temporal_realization_prediction_frozen_b.prediction_rule: If Merianieae fine persistence area > 0.022164300864659012, predict centered hidden-memory AUC effect > 0.02700779596581926; otherwise predict centered hidden-memory effect <= 0.02700779596581926.
temporal_realization_prediction_frozen_b.timing: Compute and freeze Merianieae persistence area and the implied ABOVE/AT_OR_BELOW hidden-effect prediction after state support but before informativeness and observed hidden-memory AUC.
temporal_realization_prediction_frozen_b.evaluation: After hidden-memory AUC is opened, record DIRECTION_MATCH iff observed centered effect falls on the pre-frozen predicted side of the training hidden-effect median.
